subject: We are not moving forward with your application
body_text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for applying to Nimbus Systems and for the time you spent on your application for the Data Engineer role.

After careful review, we will not be moving forward with your candidacy at this time.

We wish you all the best in your search.

Best,
The Nimbus Systems Recruiting Team
